permissionDisclosures.usageDescription: Whispr uses the camera only when you choose to join video calls or share video.
Whispr uses the microphone only when you join voice channels or calls.
Whispr uses your photo library only when you choose media to upload.
Whispr sends notifications only for account, message, and server activity you can control.
Whispr captures your screen only when you choose to share your screen in a voice room. Your entire screen, notifications, and other apps may be visible until you stop sharing.

privacyRequirements: No access token, refresh token, OAuth code, email, or message content in diagnostics.
No native permission prompt appears before a user action.
Deep links carrying credential-like query values are rejected.
Store privacy answers must match the permission disclosures in this contract.
